'''Tomatoes''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Strength}}. They replace {{MCW|Beetroot|beetroots}}. Eaten raw, they heal {{Value|Tomatoes|heals}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/matcha/tomato.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Farming ===
Tomatoes grow from [[Tomato Seeds|tomato seeds]] like beetroots. A fully grown crop drops 1 to 3 tomatoes and no seeds; an unripe one drops 1 seed. The loot table applies [[Fortune]] and the [[Electrum equipment|Electrum]] tool intrinsic and then sets the count to 1 to 3, which overrides both bonuses, so neither adds tomatoes (see [[Known bugs]]).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/beetroots.json}}</ref> Seeds are made by crafting a tomato into 3 seeds.

A crop broken by a villager drops differently: a fully grown one gives exactly 2 tomatoes and 2 tomato seeds, and an unripe one 2 seeds. This lets a [[Farmer|farmer]] villager, which can plant tomato seeds but not tomatoes, replant the crops it harvests.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/beetroots.json}}</ref><ref>{{Cite changelog|1.12.9|quote=Villagers can now replant tomatoes}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating tomatoes heals {{Value|Tomatoes|heals}}.

Picking up tomatoes unlocks [[Grilled Tomatoes|grilled tomatoes]], [[Sun-dried Tomatoes|sun-dried tomatoes]], [[bruschetta]] and [[Kontomire-Dandelion Stew|kontomire-dandelion stew]]. Tomatoes are also used in the [[Pizza|pizzas]], [[Paneer Curry Stock|paneer curry stock]] and 2 tomatoes make 2 red dye. The vanilla beetroot-to-red-dye recipe is removed.
